metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace that holds KeyringAudit_CL, in this resource group. Sentinel must already be turned on for it.
Region of the workbook. Usually the workspace's region.
Add the ASIM parsers vimAuditEventKeyring and ASimAuditEventKeyring as workspace functions.
Add the hunting queries as saved searches.
Add the Keyring workbook.
Which table the vaults' diagnostic settings write Key Vault's log to, for the two rules that compare with it: AzureDiagnostics or AZKVAuditLogs ("Resource specific").

Keyring's outbound IP addresses, as Key Vault sees them (the App Service outbound addresses, or the Container Apps environment's static outbound IP or NAT gateway). Keyring can't know these itself. Leave empty and the audit gap and unmatched SecretGet rules aren't created.

Minutes rows can take to arrive in KeyringAudit_CL after they happen. Each rule looks back this much further than it runs, and counts a row in the run after it arrives, so a late row is neither missed nor raised twice. Measure it in your workspace (see docs/sentinel.md) and set it above what you see.
Turn on: many secret reveals or private key downloads by one person in a short time.
Reveals (and private key downloads) by one person in the window that raise an alert.
Window for the many reveals rule, in minutes. The rule also runs this often.
Turn on: a reveal or private key download from an address not seen for that person in the last 14 days.
How often the new address rule runs, and how far back it looks for new reads, in hours. Sentinel needs at least an hour for a rule that looks back 14 days.
Turn on: one person denied by Key Vault in several vaults (probing).
Distinct vaults one person must be denied in to raise an alert.
Denied events one person must have, across those vaults, to raise an alert.
Window for the probing rule, in minutes. The rule also runs this often.
Turn on: a purge, private key download or other watched action outside working hours.
Actions the working hours rule watches, by exact name.
Words the working hours rule also watches for as a dotted part of an action name. "bulk" catches bulk change actions whatever they are named. Empty for none.
The organisation's offset from UTC, in minutes (600 for AEST, 660 for AEDT). Fixed: daylight saving isn't followed.
First working hour, local time, 0 to 23.
Hour working hours end, local time, 1 to 24.
Working days, 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.
How often the working hours rule runs, and the window it looks at, in minutes.
Turn on: requests Keyring refused as a forged form (csrf) or a cross-site post (cross_site).
Such refusals from one address in the window that raise an alert.
Window for the attack rule, in minutes. The rule also runs this often.
Turn on: a secret shared through Keyring with a guest account, or more than shareThreshold shares by one person in the window.
Shares by one person in the window above which an alert is raised.
Window for the shares rule, in minutes. The rule also runs this often.
Turn on: no Keyring events at all while Key Vault logged changes or reads from Keyring's outbound addresses. Needs keyringOutboundIps.
Hours with no Keyring events that count as a gap. The rule also runs this often.

Turn on: a Key Vault SecretGet from Keyring's addresses with no matching Keyring event. Not yet checked on a real vault: leave off until the real-vault checklist row "Sentinel: kv_request_id is CorrelationId" passes. Needs keyringOutboundIps.
Microsoft Sentinel severity of each rule.

variables.$fxv#0:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT' and Category == 'AuditEvent'
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId = _ResourceId, OperationName,
    Item = tostring(split(tostring(parse_url(tostring(column_ifexists('requestUri_s', ''))).Path), '/')[2]),
    CallerIpAddress = tostring(column_ifexists('CallerIPAddress', '')),
    CorrelationId = tostring(column_ifexists('CorrelationId', '')),
    CallerObjectId = coalesce(
        tostring(column_ifexists('identity_claim_http_schemas_microsoft_com_identity_claims_objectidentifier_g', '')),
        tostring(column_ifexists('identity_claim_oid_g', '')))
variables.$fxv#1:
AZKVAuditLogs
| extend Claims = column_ifexists('Identity', dynamic(null)).claim
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId = _ResourceId, OperationName,
    Item = tostring(split(tostring(parse_url(column_ifexists('RequestUri', '')).Path), '/')[2]),
    CallerIpAddress = tostring(column_ifexists('CallerIpAddress', '')),
    CorrelationId = tostring(column_ifexists('CorrelationId', '')),
    CallerObjectId = coalesce(tostring(Claims['http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/objectidentifier']), tostring(Claims.oid))
variables.$fxv#10:
// ASIM Audit Event parser for Keyring's own audit events (KeyringAudit_CL).
// Schema: AuditEvent 1.0.0. Deployed as the function vimAuditEventKeyring
// by infra/sentinel/main.bicep, which also declares its parameters.
// One output row per table row, no joins, no time filter of its own.
// Sign-in and sign-out events (session.*) are left out: they belong to the
// Authentication schema, not Audit Event.
// Never a secret value: Keyring's table has none, so NewValue stays empty.
KeyringAudit_CL
| where not(disabled)
| where isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime
| where isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime
| where not(Action startswith "session.")
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(ClientIp, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
| where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or ActorUpn has_any (actorusername_has_any)
| where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or Action has_any (operation_has_any)
| where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0
| extend Verb = tostring(split(Action, ".")[-1])
| extend EventType = case(
    Action in ("secret.reveal", "secret.copy.read", "certificate.download_private_key"), "Read",
    Verb in ("create", "upload", "import", "rotate"), "Create",
    Verb in ("delete", "purge", "cancel"), "Delete",
    Verb in ("set", "update", "rollback", "bulk_update", "write"), "Set",
    Action == "role.activate", "Enable",
    Action == "role.deactivate", "Disable",
    Action == "share.grant", "Enable",
    Action == "share.revoke", "Disable",
    "Other")
| where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in~ (eventtype_in)
| extend EventResult = iff(Outcome == "success", "Success", "Failure")
| where eventresult == "*" or EventResult =~ eventresult
| extend
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventSubType = iff(Verb == "recover", "Recover", ""),
    EventResultDetails = case(
        Outcome == "denied", "Denied by Azure",
        Outcome == "refused", "Refused by Keyring",
        Outcome == "failed", "Failed",
        ""),
    EventOriginalResultDetails = ReasonCode,
    EventSeverity = case(
        Outcome == "refused" and ReasonCode in ("csrf", "cross_site"), "Medium",
        Outcome == "success", "Informational",
        "Low"),
    EventOriginalType = Action,
    EventOriginalUid = EventId,
    EventUid = _ItemId,
    EventProduct = "Keyring",
    EventProductVersion = KeyringVersion,
    EventVendor = "Keyring",
    EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    Dvc = "Keyring",
    Operation = Action,
    Object = case(isnotempty(ItemName), strcat(Vault, "/", ItemName), isnotempty(Vault), Vault, "Keyring"),
    ObjectType = iff(isnotempty(Vault), "Cloud Resource", "Other"),
    OriginalObjectType = iff(isnotempty(ItemKind), ItemKind, iff(isnotempty(Vault), "vault", "")),
    ActorUserId = ActorObjectId,
    ActorUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(ActorObjectId), "AADID", ""),
    ActorUserAadId = ActorObjectId,
    ActorScopeId = ActorTenantId,
    ActorUsername = ActorUpn,
    ActorUsernameType = iff(isnotempty(ActorUpn), "UPN", ""),
    ActorSessionId = SessionRef,
    SrcIpAddr = ClientIp,
    HttpUserAgent = UserAgent,
    TargetAppName = "Keyring",
    TargetAppType = "Service",
    AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
        "ReasonCode", ReasonCode,
        "ItemVersion", ItemVersion,
        "KvRequestId", KvRequestId,
        "Reason", Reason,
        "Ticket", Ticket,
        "Role", column_ifexists("Role", ""),
        "RoleScope", column_ifexists("RoleScope", ""),
        "RoleDuration", column_ifexists("RoleDuration", ""),
        "NotifyType", column_ifexists("NotifyType", ""),
        "NotifyRecipientCount", column_ifexists("NotifyRecipientCount", int(null)),
        "NotifyRecipients", column_ifexists("NotifyRecipients", ""),
        "NotifyEventCount", column_ifexists("NotifyEventCount", int(null)),
        "RevealLimitFrom", column_ifexists("RevealLimitFrom", ""),
        "RevealLimitTo", column_ifexists("RevealLimitTo", ""),
        "SharePrincipalId", column_ifexists("SharePrincipalId", ""),
        "SharePrincipalType", column_ifexists("SharePrincipalType", ""),
        "ShareUntil", column_ifexists("ShareUntil", ""),
        "SharePath", column_ifexists("SharePath", ""),
        "WriterIdentityClientId", WriterIdentityClientId,
        "KeyringInstance", KeyringInstance)
| where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any)
| extend
    User = ActorUsername,
    IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
    Src = SrcIpAddr,
    Application = TargetAppName
| project-away Verb
variables.$fxv#13:
// Certificate private keys downloaded through Keyring.
let who = "";
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Action == "certificate.download_private_key"
| where isempty(who) or ActorUpn contains who or ActorObjectId =~ who
| project TimeGenerated, ActorUpn, ActorObjectId, Vault, ItemName, Outcome, ReasonCode, ClientIp, KvRequestId, Reason, Ticket
| order by TimeGenerated desc
variables.$fxv#14:
// Deletes, purges and recoveries of secrets, certificates and keys through Keyring.
let who = "";
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Action in ("secret.delete", "secret.purge", "secret.recover",
    "certificate.delete", "certificate.purge", "certificate.recover",
    "key.delete", "key.purge", "key.recover")
| where isempty(who) or ActorUpn contains who or ActorObjectId =~ who
| project TimeGenerated, Action, ActorUpn, ActorObjectId, Vault, ItemKind, ItemName, Outcome, ReasonCode, ClientIp, KvRequestId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
variables.$fxv#15:
// What Keyring refused, or Azure denied, counted by person, vault and reason.
let who = "";
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Outcome in ("refused", "denied")
| where isempty(who) or ActorUpn contains who or ActorObjectId =~ who
| summarize Count = count(), LastTime = max(TimeGenerated), Actions = make_set(Action, 10), Addresses = make_set(ClientIp, 10)
    by ActorObjectId, ActorUpn, Vault, Outcome, ReasonCode
| order by Count desc
variables.$fxv#7:
// Secrets shared through Keyring (#286) that need a look: a share to a
// guest account, or more than shareThreshold shares by one person in the
// window. Rows can arrive late, so the rule looks back window + delay, and
// only alerts when a row counted arrived in the last window.
// Set by main.bicep: window, delay, shareThreshold
KeyringAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(window + delay)
| where Action == "share.grant" and Outcome == "success"
| extend PrincipalType = tostring(column_ifexists("SharePrincipalType", "")),
    PrincipalId = tostring(column_ifexists("SharePrincipalId", ""))
| summarize Shares = count(), Guests = countif(PrincipalType == "guest"),
    Recipients = make_set(PrincipalId, 20), Vaults = make_set(Vault, 10), Items = make_set(ItemName, 20),
    ClientIp = take_any(ClientIp), ActorUpn = take_any(ActorUpn),
    FirstTime = min(TimeGenerated), LastTime = max(TimeGenerated), TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated),
    LastArrived = max(coalesce(ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated))
    by ActorObjectId
| where (Guests > 0 or Shares > shareThreshold) and LastArrived > ago(window)

[format('Keyring refused {0} or more requests from one address in {1} minutes as a forged form (csrf) or a cross-site post (cross_site): a possible attack on Keyring itself.', parameters('attackThreshold'), parameters('attackWindowMinutes'))]
